epics.title: Runtime Environment Initialization Repair
epics.jtbd: When the end customer attempts to launch the application, I want the system to start successfully without network conflicts, so that the product is actually available for use.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application initialization failure rate from 100% to 0%
requirements: R1: Fix invalid Flyway migration filenames so all database migrations execute successfully on launch.

slices.title: Fix Flyway Migration Naming Conventions
slices.jtbd: When implementing database initialization for this epic, I want to rename the invalid Flyway migration files, so that the system starts successfully.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the application startup sequence is triggered
When Flyway executes the database migrations
Then all SQL files are successfully validated and applied
And the application health check endpoint returns an HTTP 200 OK status
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce undetected Flyway migration files from 2 to 0
